chapter_narration:stg0026_194.text: So at least you, if no one else...

chapter_narration:stg0052_114.text: The cycle of the cosmos, the cycle of life

chapter_narration:stg0052_154.text: All long to break free of these cycles.

chapter_narration:stg0052_194.text: That is the path to evolution...

chapter_narration:stg0083_172.text: Days of peace, untouched by anyone

chapter_narration:stg0083_1b8.text: Why...? Why do you reject them?

chapter_narration:stg0098a_188.text: The door opens, and the future closes
